options.name: comment
options.description: Configures a text string comment to be associated with the instance of this object.  The provided text string will be configured on the object instance.

options.name: contact
options.description: Contact information for person/team managing or using VLAN.

options.name: description
options.description: Description for the VLAN object, may be potentially used for longer VLAN names.

options.name: extattrs
options.description: Allows for the configuration of Extensible Attributes on the instance of the object.  This argument accepts a set of key / value pairs for configuration.

options.name: id
options.description: Specifies the vlan id to add or remove from the system.

options.name: name
options.description: Specifies the vlan name to add or remove from the system.

options.name: parent
options.description: Specifies the vlan parent to add or remove from the system. Can be either a C(vlanview) or C(vlanrange) name. Fetches the required _ref object automatically. If not specified defaults to vlan view C(default).

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: reserved
options.description: When set VLAN can only be assigned to IPAM object manually.

options.name: state
options.description: Configures the intended state of the instance of the object on the NIOS server.  When this value is set to C(present), the object is configured on the device and when this value is set to C(absent) the value is removed (if necessary) from the device.
